def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    contracts = 5
    shares_per_contract = 100
    premium_received = 2.50
    strike_price = 150
    market_price = 158
    shares_bought_price = 140

    # Calculate the covered call profit: stock gain up to the strike plus premium
    shares = contracts * shares_per_contract
    total_premium = premium_received * shares
    stock_sale_price = min(market_price, strike_price)
    stock_profit = (stock_sale_price - shares_bought_price) * shares
    answer = round(total_premium + stock_profit)

    # return answer
    return answer
